column1: # sdk-matrix-expectations.tsv — per-version expectation table for the
# scripts/sdk-feature-ladder.txt (the feature rungs this table keys from).
# WHY: the gate corpora pin `environment: sdk: ^3.13.0` and
# reads a language version it does not know and clamps to its own max, so
# version-gated fixture faces flip per oracle version — and the gate bar is
# full parity (threshold 1.0), so every unattributed one-sided entry fails
# the gate. This table is the committed record of which one-sided entries are
# EXPECTED at which oracle version, so a probe-triaged face is distinguishable
# from a regression. Classification in the summary (removedIn / addedIn skew)
# stays advisory and separate; this table is documentation, checked only for
#   minor       oracle language minor the row applies to (`*` = all), a
#   kind        clamp          version-gated fixture face flips or goes
#                              silent at this minor (feature rung above it)
#               lint           lint-gate face whose firing is version-scoped
#               sdk-constraint faces on the corpora's `sdk: ^3.13.0` pin
#   face        face family name (free text, no `|`)
# PROBE PHASE CONTRACT: every UNKNOWN-until-probed row is filled by one
# probe run per oracle version (harness run or bare `dart analyze` over the
# corpora), recording the measured face outcome. A row measured as "both
# sides emit identically" is deleted, not marked fires — the table carries
# Severe known direction (from the feature rungs, not yet measured per
# version): below the extension-types rung (3.3) and the digit-separators
# rung (3.6), dartq-only faces in those families are addedIn-skew (ladder
# attribution); below the wildcard-variables rung (3.7) the flip is
# ORACLE-side (a clamped language makes `_` binding again, so the oracle can
# emit extra faces dartq never emits — a gate-visible divergence, not
# attributable as skew); below the dot-shorthands rung (3.10) the oracle may
# emit parser recodes on dot-shorthand fixture faces (oracle-side); below
# the primary-constructors rung (3.13) primary-constructor faces recode or
# Lint face: no_duplicate_case_values fires only when the effective language
# version is <= 2.19 (legacy switch-case member shape; the face is gated on
# the patterns feature, silent iff patterns on — patterns enabledIn 3.0.0).
# The sweep floor is Dart 3.0.7, so this is silent on every ladder oracle;
# it becomes oracle-side fires only if the mixed-versions corpus (2.x rows)
# SDK-constraint face: whether an oracle below 3.13 additionally emits an
# SDK-constraint face on the `sdk: ^3.13.0` pubspec (refusing or warning)
# is unpinned — measured per version by the probe phase, never guessed.
# Never-fires fixture faces (documented version-scoped in the m0-syntax
# corpus README's blindspot accounting): per-version behavior unprobed.

# to generic parser faces or go silent on a pre-extension-types oracle.
